title: The role of nano-biochar reduces the impact of phenanthrene on wheat photosynthesis
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,1881-1895
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00887A, Paper
Menghan Cui, Jin Zhang, Chenghao Huang, Shuangyuan Xu, Bożena Czech, Jianggang Han, Yu Shen, Xinhua Zhan
Nano-biochar effectively mitigates phenanthrene toxicity in wheat by reducing its uptake and improving photosynthetic efficiency, with 1.0 mg L−1 nano-biochar increasing chlorophyll content by 14.54% and enhancing photosystem II function.
